title: Editor Backend Core Live Compatibility Harness Checklist

items.label: Capture current Project Control, Core, Editor, and Backend heads, working agreements, and compatibility blockers before editing.
items.evidenceTarget: Exact commit IDs, clean git status, AGENTS.md boundaries, and prior Core gate-stability evidence are reviewed.

items.label: Confirm the live harness belongs in Editor without moving Backend transport, Core semantics, or Project Control truth responsibilities.
items.evidenceTarget: Editor, Backend, and Core boundary files show the harness can use public surfaces without product-runtime responsibility drift.

items.label: Write an Editor-owned failing test for the real loopback Backend server and real Editor backend client path.
items.evidenceTarget: The focused Editor test fails before implementation because the accepted live harness is not yet wired.

items.label: Implement the minimal test-only wiring needed for the live capability, read, migration, mutation, and runtime apply path.
items.evidenceTarget: The Editor diff keeps production runtime behavior unchanged and uses Backend/Core public contracts.

items.label: Run focused and full owner repository gates after the harness is in place.
items.evidenceTarget: Editor focused harness, Editor npm run check, and any required Backend/Core gates or no-change evidence are recorded.

items.label: Register the live harness evidence in Project Control without promoting broad FlowDoc truth.
items.evidenceTarget: Evidence target evidence-editor-backend-core-live-compatibility-harness-2026-08-27 records the commit, checks, supported claim, risks, and intentionally unpromoted truth.
